summary: Clene Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a firm-commitment underwritten public offering of 1,000,000 shares of common stock at $7.00 per share. Canaccord Genuity LLC is the sole bookrunner; Maxim Group LLC and D. Boral Capital LLC serve as financial advisors receiving 15% of underwriting discounts. Net proceeds of ~$6.4 million will fund NDA preparation for CNM-Au8, expanded access protocols, Phase 3 trial, manufacturing, commercialization, and R&D. Standard 60-day lock-up applies to officers, directors, and affiliates. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation event, and does not trigger activist, M&A, or restructuring classification.
